input.question: When was the Sumter County Courthouse built?

documents.text: a Revolutionary War hero who served in the U.S. Senate. The first courthouse was a log structure in 1833 and served the county until 1837. In 1838, a second courthouse was constructed but collapsed and was torn down. Sumter became the center of antebellum civilization in 1840. A third courthouse was constructed in 1855 and served until 1901 when it was destroyed by fire. Its cornerstone was laid in 1902, and the two-story brick and stone building still serves the county.
